record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.original_question: Does there exist a Polish space, or even a locally compact space, that is 1/aleph_1-CDH, meaning that it has exactly aleph_1 equivalence classes of countable dense subsets under self-homeomorphisms?

evidence.quote: Problem 26. Is there a (Polish, locally compact) space which is 1 ω1 -CDH?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A separable topological space $X$ is called countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if for any two countable dense subsets $D, E \subseteq X$ there exists a self-homeomorphism $h : X \to X$ with $h(D) = E$. More generally, on the set of all countable dense subsets of $X$ define the equivalence relation $D \sim E$ iff some self-homeomorphism of $X$ maps $D$ onto $E$. For a cardinal $\kappa$, say that $X$ is $\tfrac{1}{\kappa}$-CDH if this equivalence relation has exactly $\kappa$ equivalence classes. (A Polish space is a separable completely metrizable topological space; a locally compact space is one in which every point has a compact neighborhood.)

Question: Does there exist a Polish space, or even a locally compact (Hausdorff) space, that is $\tfrac{1}{\aleph_1}$-CDH, i.e., one whose countable dense subsets fall into exactly $\aleph_1$ equivalence classes under self-homeomorphisms?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a published list of open problems on countable dense homogeneity and no resolution was located via web search. Related work on CDH and cardinalities of CDH spaces (e.g., results on CDH subsets of the reals of size ℵ₁, and consistency results on possible cardinalities of CDH metric spaces) exists, but none reported answer the specific question of producing a Polish or locally compact space with exactly ℵ₁ homeomorphism-orbits of countable dense sets.

status_evidence.title: A countable dense homogeneous set of reals of size ℵ₁
status_evidence.snippet: There is a countable dense homogeneous subspace of ℝ of size ℵ₁.
status_evidence.claim: Related CDH results concerning size ℵ₁ exist, but address CDH (one orbit) rather than exactly ℵ₁ orbits.

status_evidence.title: On the cardinality of countable dense homogeneous spaces
status_evidence.snippet: It is consistent with ZFC that every CDH metric space has size either ω₁ or c.
status_evidence.claim: Cardinality questions for CDH spaces are studied, but the existence of a 1/ℵ₁-CDH Polish or locally compact space is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Nearly Countable Dense Homogeneous Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses spaces with few orbits of countable dense subsets under self-homeomorphism.
status_evidence.claim: Provides background on counting orbits of countable dense subsets but does not settle the ℵ₁ case for Polish or locally compact spaces.
